# Burthorpe Games Room

minigames/game_gamesroom. Entered by the stairs in Burthorpe (board_game_stairs_grey_all at (2899, 3566), ladders+stairs/scripts/stairs.rs2:485), which land on one of six tiles at random (stairs.rs2:491), so sources/connectors.ts derives no landing: gates.ts CURATED_CROSSINGS has the stairs each way. The barmaid is traded with from up to 3 tiles off, across her bar (minigames/game_gamesroom/general/scripts/boardgames_barmaid.rs2:12), so the shop's stand is in front of it.
